description: The Barbados Statistical Service published the report of the 2021 Population and Housing Census, taken on 1 August 2021, as a 94 page PDF. Its housing chapter gives three tables of dwelling units by parish and occupancy status: by dwelling type, by type of roof and by material of the outer walls. The roof table separates low gable, high gable, flat or split, hip and combination roofs, a split that matters for hurricane wind loads; nationally it counts 73,571 dwelling units, of which 37,796 have a low gable roof and 4,011 a combination roof. Coverage is national by parish. Format and access: free PDF download, no registration, with the 2010 and 2000 census reports on the same page. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Barbados Statistical Service Open Licence Agreement. Caveats: the 2021 report has no tables on water, electricity or sanitation, and the parish is the only geography; about 3,650 dwellings have a not stated occupancy status. Simulation uses: roof shape and wall material counts by parish for hurricane damage and exposure models. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub for other Caribbean census databases.
